dedupe_keys.name: zero touch digital twin for smart city waste management

description: A Multimedia University researcher publishes sensor readings and seeded simulations for a smart-bin waste collection study. Zenodo supplies one ZIP under CC BY 4.0. Its description identifies 241 physical readings from a single student-dormitory bin over 61 hourly buckets in June 2026. The archive also includes synthetic histories for another 99 bins and routing benchmark results from 240 runs. These inputs can test bin-fill forecasting and route-planning components in municipal waste simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this pilot bundle. A limitation is that the physical sample covers one bin for four days and has no ground-truth labels. Synthetic bins and benchmark scores do not establish field performance across a city. The wider study cites public Melbourne and Kaggle data but does not redistribute them. The ZIP was not downloaded or its internal columns checked.
